role: retrospective internal predictive evaluation, not untouched external validation
split: All 6 x 8 leave-one-disease-animal/one-control-animal pairs; exclude every brain region of both animals from fitting
noise: Within-training-group paired residual correlation, 50% identity shrinkage; plug-in Gaussian approximation
feature_rule: Provided upstream-filtered universe. Only finite training effects with positive SE in every region; no outcome-based selection or hyperparameter tuning
target: Squared prediction error for held-out case-control log2 sum-scaled expression contrasts, averaged over genes and available regions
uncertainty: Folds overlap: 48 paired folds are NOT 48 independent experiments. Report paired fold errors and aggregate descriptive MSE without iid fold confidence intervals
limits: Upstream feature filtering used all source samples
Held-out contrast is noisy, not the true biological effect
Models are existing empirical-Bayes constructions, not new inventions
